title: Dr. Dániel Kurcz
seoTitle: Dr. Dániel Kurcz – Attorney at law
description: Dr. Dániel Kurcz. Attorney at law. Professional background and contact information at Bihary Balassa in Budapest.

content.text: Lawyer. Graduated “cum laude” from Eötvös Loránd University Budapest in 2016. Prior to graduation, he also worked as a trainee at our office. Specialized fields: corporate and contract law, real property law, litigation and compensation law, debt management. He has an intermediate command of English.
